description: Post-1.0 Phase 13 — Android device lifecycle QA matrix against Phase 28 browser-lifecycle catalog. Covers background, resume, rotate (no recreate), process-death restore, and low-memory checkpoint.

deviceClasses.note: Primary Play phone screenshots + fullSensor HUD reflow.

scenarios.title: Background / onStop
scenarios.trigger: Home / app switch / screen off → Activity.onStop

scenarios.title: Rotate / size change without recreate
scenarios.trigger: Device rotation or foldable size change

scenarios.title: Process death / cold start restore
scenarios.trigger: System kills process after onStop; user relaunches

scenarios.title: Low memory / onTrimMemory
scenarios.trigger: TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_LOW or more severe while Activity alive

manualChecklist: Phone: Play → Home → Recent → resume; coins/tick unchanged except offline catch-up
Phone: rotate portrait↔landscape mid-sale; no title reload
Developer options → Don't keep activities: leave and return restores from AtomicFile
Low memory: adb shell am send-trim-memory <pkg> RUNNING_LOW → no crash; save slots updated
failCriteria: Activity recreate on rotate (loses Filament / billing host)
Missing checkpoint on background (empty save after process death)
